2124312976853446810.en_summary: $SPCX compute-only position (giving no weight to StarLink, orbital lift, or Grok SI) is looking increasingly stronger. AI demand will keep rising and new chips will make every GW of power increasingly more valuable. Quoted @elonmusk noting the difficulty of getting large amounts of compute turned on, cooled and working reliably, and that cash shortages will be severe next year due to delays between paying for compute and generating revenue.
2124312976853446810.zh_summary: $SPCX 僅計算力的持倉（不考慮 Starlink、軌道發射或 Grok SI）看起來越來越強。AI 需求將持續上升，新晶片將使每一吉瓦電力越來越有價值。引用 @elonmusk 指出大規模運算上線、冷卻並可靠運作極為困難，明年因支付運算費用與產生收入之間的延遲將出現嚴重現金短缺。
